prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. Return ONE complete 1536x1024 literary-room activity mother.
INPUT ROLES: IMAGE 1 is the root-approved EMPTY matching weather/time room, authoritative for full room geometry, camera and LIGHT. IMAGE 2 is the root-approved APRICOT SAME-ACTIVITY mother, authoritative for this character's identity, exact pose, body proportions, image location, support, hands and small objects. Use ONLY these two approved inputs. This is a light/weather change preserving a correct pose, NOT a new activity or free pose redraw.
LOCK the source camera/perspective/window divisions and all major furniture to image 1: desk/chair, shelves/plants/books/pictures, original ceramic lamp/round table/cup/flowers, right bench/pillows/knitted throw, foreground depth/rug/floor. Preserve image 2's complete source figure: head angle/gaze, hair silhouette, torso/back/pelvis, elbows/wrists/palms/fingers, skirt/legs and complete shoes. Same youthful body size and source positions; no zoom, head enlargement, leaning toward lens, body translation, crop or moved furniture. True hip/cushion, back/pillow, hand/object and shoe/floor contacts remain. Complete head/hair, hands, hem and both shoes in frame. Never replace with chat/listening pose.
REPAINT physically coherent illumination across the ENTIRE person, hair/skin/clothes, paper/books/pencil where present, cushion/contact receiver, wood and floor to image 1. The old hard sunny window bars, hot skin patches and gold noon rim are NOT identity: remove/repaint them under new weather. Match material reflections, contact softness, exposure and lamp falloff. Not a CSS/global color wash, pasted sunny figure or half-day/half-night split. No added lamp or prop; keep interior dry.
Clear fine original youthful anime linework in rich painted room. Hair groups/cheek strands, eyelids/lashes, iris and pupil readable and separate even in downcast/profile eyes. No dark fringe/eye fusion, mature glamour or chibi. No UI, readable text, labels, card, badge, bubble, trail, arrow, halo, signature, watermark or split view.

Umiri/八幡海铃: exact charcoal layered shoulder-length hair, gray-teal irises, small earrings/choker, black leather jacket, burgundy top, gray belted skirt and full black lace-up platform boots from image 2. Hair/leather/cloth remain different materials. Preserve source separate side-by-side knees, two continuous naturally parallel calves and two complete boots each bearing weight on original floor. Never held old crossed-knee v1, no detached calf/boot or new leg crossing.
REST — preserve original body reclined into plaid pillow, LOWER head and sideward window-facing profile, both EMPTY hands resting across lap/knees. Her eye visible in profile stays readable, no head turn to camera or generic smile. Approved lower head is rested perspective, not a size error to normalize. Keep actual two knees/calves/independent boots. Letting vigilance soften is not rain-induced sadness or sleep.
RAIN / RAIN NIGHT: exact image 1 dark cloudy rainy sky, drops/trails on glass and rain-broken town/lake reflections. Original ceramic lamp provides local warm interior glow with natural falloff; faint cool window fill separates far contours without neon. Person, hair/skin/clothes/WHITE PAPER/boots, cushion and floor all share night exposure; NO old daytime bars, solar skin patches or pasted bright noon head. Indoor fabric/floor/books stay DRY, rain only outside/on glass. No moon/stars/new fixture. Preserve activity emotion: rain does NOT automatically mean sadness.
